text:
Clara Holt: Quick QA note 1: the inline pill-style action in the Services table reads heavier than the same pill in the Edit Config modal. also toasts slide in from bottom-left and briefly cover the pill on narrow screens. anyone seen this?

Owen Patel: saw this on mobile breakpoints. I think the table uses `--rwd-pill-compact-pad` while modal uses `--rwd-pill-pad`. subtle but noticeable. :mag: 

Mira Singh: yep token drift. we intended pills to share spacing tokens with buttons but a few legacy selectors still reference `legacy-pill-*`.

Clara Holt: repro: Console > Services > hover row > inline pill (Deploy) vs open Service > Edit config modal > Deploy (pill). Trigger a toast by saving. On 360px the toast overlaps the inline pill for ~200ms.

Owen Patel: snippet from storybook:
```css
.pill { padding: var(--rwd-pill-pad); border-radius: var(--rwd-radius-pill); }
.table .row .pill { padding-inline: var(--rwd-pill-compact-pad); }
.toast { left: 12px; bottom: 12px; transform: translateY(8px); transition: transform 240ms ease; }
```

Mira Singh: proposals:
- consolidate to a single pill horizontal token `--rwd-pill-inline` instead of compact/legacy
- add `--rwd-toast-safe-gap` token components can read to add a bottom offset when toast present
- standardize toast entrance to 200ms to match other overlays
- ensure min hit target 44x44 and focus ring 3px with `--rwd-focus-strong` color

Clara Holt: agreed. tiny copy nit: inline pill says "Deploy" while modal shows "Deploy changes". keep inline short. update docs under Buttons -> Inline actions guidance.

Owen Patel: for implementation, I'd avoid increasing z-index for toasts. reserving space via `toast-safe-gap` feels safer for a11y overlays. Also add a combined story (table + modal + toast) to catch it in visual tests.

DesignBot: Preview build queued for branch `ui/pill-token-sync` (PR #4555) 1:12:05. Running visual-regression and a11y checks.

Mira Singh: added a migration note in tokens.md and replaced hard-coded px in the table styles. pushed a small PR; will add the combined story next.

QA-Bot: visual snapshots queued. Reminder: include dark-theme screenshot for focus contrast.

Owen Patel: one more nit  the pill press ripple duration differs (150ms vs 200ms). can we standardize to 180ms? less janky with toasts at 200ms.

Clara Holt: go with 180ms for press, 200ms for toast entrance. Looks good. Assigning @Mira for token PR, @Owen for test stories and QA.

DesignBot: PR #4555 built and merged to staging. Visual diffs: 3 stories updated (pills/inline, modal/pill, toast/safety-gap). a11y-lint: 0 failures, 1 advisory on dark focus contrast assigned to Mira.
